profile.authority: U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER)
profile.title: General Considerations for the Use of New Approach Methodologies in Drug Development

source_metadata.issuing_office: Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER)
source_metadata.regulatory_status: Draft — Not for Implementation; contains nonbinding recommendations
source_metadata.curation_method: Manual structured curation from the official FDA PDF. Requirements are paraphrases of Section III validation considerations, not verbatim regulatory text.
source_metadata.scope_note: The FDA guidance describes broad validation considerations for NAMs used in drug development and is not specific to a particular NAM.

requirements.title: Define the Context of Use and decision purpose
requirements.requirement_text: Define the NAM's intended use and regulatory purpose in a specific drug-development decision context, including the question or data gap the NAM is intended to address.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.A Context of Use; guidance p. 5; lines 136-147
requirements.interpretation_note: Curated from a nonbinding recommendation. Whether the stated CoU is sufficiently specific and decision-relevant remains a human regulatory/scientific judgment.

requirements.title: Describe physiologic and model-system relevance
requirements.requirement_text: Describe the physiological features assessed by the NAM, including relevant cell types, species of origin, and how anatomical and physiological characteristics relevant to toxicity are represented by the platform.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.B Human Biological Relevance; guidance pp. 5-6; lines 151-177
requirements.interpretation_note: The appropriate biological features depend on the NAM and CoU; the FDA text gives organ-specific examples rather than a universal feature list.

curation.source_basis: Section III.B first bullet and examples

requirements.title: Show that relevant toxicological findings can be evaluated
requirements.requirement_text: Provide evidence that toxicological findings relevant to the declared CoU can be evaluated reliably with the NAM and its selected endpoints.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.B Human Biological Relevance; guidance p. 6; lines 179-186
requirements.interpretation_note: Endpoint adequacy is context-specific. Example biomarkers in the FDA text should not be treated as universally required endpoints.

requirements.title: Connect modeled mechanisms to human outcomes
requirements.requirement_text: Describe how biological mechanisms investigated by the NAM relate to outcomes relevant to human clinical testing or human toxicity assessment.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.B Human Biological Relevance; guidance p. 6; lines 188-194
requirements.interpretation_note: Mechanistic-to-clinical relevance cannot be established by metadata completeness alone and should remain subject to qualified review.

requirements.title: Document test-method details and variability sources
requirements.requirement_text: Document test-method details relevant to reproducibility, including dosing, test-substance handling, detection/instrumentation, material compatibility, and steps that may introduce assay variability.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.C Technical Characterization; guidance p. 7; lines 204-207
requirements.interpretation_note: The listed examples are representative; method-specific details should be selected for the actual NAM.

requirements.title: Document statistical analysis and interpretation criteria
requirements.requirement_text: Describe statistical methods and the criteria used to interpret NAM results, including how positive, negative, or inconclusive outcomes are determined when applicable.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.C Technical Characterization; guidance p. 7; lines 209-210
requirements.interpretation_note: The relevant statistical methods and decision criteria depend on the NAM and endpoint.

requirements.title: Characterize predictive performance for the specific CoU
requirements.requirement_text: Characterize predictive performance for the declared Context of Use using appropriate performance measures such as sensitivity and specificity where they are meaningful.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.C Technical Characterization; guidance p. 7; lines 212-213
requirements.interpretation_note: No universal performance threshold is inferred. Choice of metrics and adequacy are CoU-dependent.

requirements.title: Establish assay working duration and stability
requirements.requirement_text: Characterize the period over which the assay produces stable results and evaluate stability as assay materials are replaced or resupplied over time.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.C Technical Characterization; guidance p. 7; lines 215-218
requirements.interpretation_note: Applicability depends on whether the NAM has a meaningful working-duration or material/batch lifecycle.

requirements.title: Document cell or tissue source and preparation
requirements.requirement_text: For cell- or tissue-based NAMs, document the cell type, isolation or differentiation methods, source information, relevant batch/catalog identifiers, and species.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.C Technical Characterization; guidance p. 7; lines 220-222
requirements.interpretation_note: This is not applicable to all computational or non-cellular NAMs.

requirements.title: Characterize biological and donor variability
requirements.requirement_text: Where biological or donor variability is relevant, describe factors such as genetics and donor phenotype in relation to the Context of Use.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.C Technical Characterization; guidance p. 7; lines 224-225
requirements.interpretation_note: Which variability factors matter is CoU-specific and should not be reduced to a fixed demographic checklist.

requirements.title: Justify reference-compound or control selection
requirements.requirement_text: Define and justify appropriate reference compounds or controls used to demonstrate scientific validity and performance of the NAM.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.C Technical Characterization; guidance p. 7; lines 227-228
requirements.interpretation_note: The appropriate positive/negative controls and their number depend on the method, endpoint, and CoU.

requirements.title: Document culture medium and maintenance conditions
requirements.requirement_text: For culture-based NAMs, document the composition of the culture medium and relevant maintenance conditions such as passage, incubation, and surface-coating conditions.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.C Technical Characterization; guidance p. 7; lines 230-232
requirements.interpretation_note: This requirement is specific to culture-based NAMs; equivalent technical controls may differ for other method families.

requirements.title: Address platform- and device-specific technical effects
requirements.requirement_text: For relevant platforms or devices, document technical and material characteristics that can affect biological relevance or variability and evaluate potential test-article/platform interactions or material-compatibility effects.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.C Technical Characterization; guidance pp. 7-8; lines 234-249
requirements.interpretation_note: FDA presents organ chips as an example. Applicability to a given NAM requires method-specific judgment.

requirements.title: Compare performance with established methods when available
requirements.requirement_text: When a traditional comparator method exists, provide comparative performance data addressing whether the NAM characterizes the relevant risk at least as well as the established method.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.D Fit-for-Purpose; guidance p. 8; lines 256-259
requirements.interpretation_note: This recommendation is explicitly conditional on availability of a traditional comparator. No universal superiority threshold is inferred.

requirements.title: Describe benefits, limitations, and interpretive constraints
requirements.requirement_text: Discuss the NAM's benefits and limitations, including study-design or conduct features that may affect reliability, reproducibility, or the ability to inform risk assessment for the intended CoU.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.D Fit-for-Purpose; guidance p. 8; lines 261-263
requirements.interpretation_note: Limitations should remain visible even when other evidence requirements are well supported.

requirements.title: Explain contribution to overall human health or safety risk assessment
requirements.requirement_text: Describe how findings from the NAM contribute to the overall determination of risks to human health or drug safety in the declared Context of Use and weight of evidence.
requirements.source_locator: Section III.D Fit-for-Purpose; guidance p. 8; lines 265-266; see also background lines 34-40
requirements.interpretation_note: This is an integrative scientific/regulatory interpretation and must not be auto-resolved from structural completeness alone.

curation.source_basis: Section III.D third bullet plus weight-of-evidence context
